requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 95 sqm of gross floor area.

User prefers energy class C or better, so energy_class is restricted to A1-A4, B and C. Floor area (95 sqm), capacity, city (Turin) and green-space proximity are not energy requirements and are not included.
The user wants the property near green spaces. Per the 'near' expression, the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 95 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND green >= 74 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on surface_area (>= 95 sqm), energy_class (A1-A4, B, C), and green (>= 74), plus a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Results are ordered by distance from that point. The tipologia_bene_immobile requirement was omitted because that column is not in the filterable_columns allowlist (property_type is the filterable equivalent, but it was not supplied as a requirement).
